tag: S-12 shipped default: weight_mode=invvol, alloc_vol_window=21, alloc_vol_power=1.0 (risk parity inside the top_n); must reproduce OrderListHash 5246804e17a67af90028ffceead7d3b3
note: S-12 changed how the exposure budget is split between the names momentum has already picked, so the order list moved again: OrderListHash is now 5246804e17a67af90028ffceead7d3b3, not ff4a7cbaaf6e36e58ace2b82ab216bdf. The only change from S-10 is weight_mode='invvol' with alloc_vol_window=21 and alloc_vol_power=1.0: a winner's share of the budget is proportional to 1/sigma on its own trailing one-month vol, measured on the *unlevered* ranked series, instead of 1/N. Equal weight equalized notional, so the most volatile winner supplied most of the book's variance, and this sleeve spans GLD/TLT near 12% vol and XLE/XLK near 30%. Sub-periods, both from LEAN: IS 2012-2019 19.18% CAR / 0.884 Sharpe / 25.1% DD (run 20260909T041413Z) beats the S-10 champion's 17.64% / 0.801 / 25.9% on all three; OOS 2020-2026 30.86% / 0.985 / 22.6% (run 20260909T041644Z) beats its 31.09% / 0.972 / 21.5% on Sharpe, is 0.23 points behind on CAR and 1.1 points worse on drawdown. It is a shelf, not a spike: at power 1.0 the vol windows 20, 21 and 30 all beat the champion on CAR, Sharpe and drawdown (24.25/0.915, 24.40/0.921, 24.18/0.911), 40 and 60 beat it on Sharpe and drawdown but not CAR, and 10 loses outright; 21 is one trading month, the a-priori point inside the shelf, and 20 is the argmax. The tilt is also monotone in strength - power 0.5 at the same window gives 24.10 / 0.902, half the gain for half the tilt. Cost: it re-weights as the vol ratios drift, so orders rise 2,573 -> 4,735 and fees $37.4k -> $45.7k; a longer window is the fallback if commission rises. Reproduce with: py -3.11 scripts/backtest.py s1_momo (no env vars); S1_WEIGHT_MODE=equal restores the S-10 champion. I-1 note: the paper runner's order list changes with this promotion, so the pre-deploy comparison must be made against this hash; --mock --dry-run was re-verified against it on 2026-09-09. Harness caveat: scripts/sweep_s1.py agreed on the direction this time but understated it, scoring the same cell at 22.1% CAR / 1.09 against a 21.2% / 1.03 equal-weight baseline, and it also understates the drawdown by ~6 points.
